result.topic_en: Bare calculations transforming a second-order partial differential equation in variables y, y' (substitutions u = P(p)·sqrt((1+y)(1+y')) and u = v·sqrt((y+1)(y'+1))), computing derivatives in terms of p and arriving at an equation with coefficients 1/4·1/(yy'-1) and nn/(yy'-1)^2.

$P\sqrt{(1+y)(1+y')}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = 2\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}(1+y)^2 - 2\frac{\partial u}{\partial y'}(1+y')^2$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial p}\left(y'(1+y)^2 - y(1+y')^2\right)(y-y')\,p-1$
[-$q$-] $\frac{\partial p}{\partial x} = 2(y-y')(p-1)$
$\frac{\partial q}{\partial x} = \frac12 q(1+y) - (1+y') = \frac12 q(y-y')$
$\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial p}(p-1) + \frac12 P\right) q(y-y')$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 P}{\partial p^2}(p-1) + \frac32\frac{\partial P}{\partial p}\right) q(y-y')^2(p-1)$
$\frac{\partial P}{\partial}$ $-2p$

$\left(4\frac{\partial^2 P}{\partial p^2}(p-1)^2 + 5\frac{\partial P}{\partial p}(p-1) + P\right) q(y-y')^2$
$+\left(2\frac{\partial P}{\partial p}(p-1) + P\right) 2q\,(1+y)^2 + (1+y')^2$

$+4(y+y')\left(2\frac{\partial P}{\partial p}(p-1)+P\right) + y^2+y'^2$
